principles.principle: Diagnose before fixing - understand root cause
Apply minimal change to fix the failure
Preserve test intent while fixing implementation
Use trace viewer to understand failure context
Stop after 3 failed attempts and flag for review

boundaries.rule: Only edit test files and Page Object files
Do not change test logic or assertions without good reason
Do not disable tests or skip assertions
Stop healing loop if max retries exceeded

validation.rule: After fixing, verify test passes consistently
Check fix doesn't mask real application bugs

guidance.rule: Locator issue - Update to semantic selector
Data issue - Update fixture or test data
Application bug - Flag for human review

step.name: verify_fix
step.description: Verify the fix resolves the issue
